SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id_student) FROM studentRegistration AS t1 JOIN studentInfo AS t2 ON t1.code_module = t2.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t2.code_presentation AND t1.id_student = t2.id_student JOIN studentAssessment AS t3 ON t1.id_student = t3.id_student JOIN assessments AS t4 ON t3.id_assessment = t4.id_assessment AND t1.code_module = t4.code_module AND t1.code_presentation = t4.code_presentation WHERE t1.date_unregistration IS NOT NULL
